# Introduction {.unnumbered}

**Unit 6: AI in the Real World** (Weeks 14-15)

What AI means for your privacy, your future job, your school, and the news you see. We will look at real scams, real changes happening in the workplace right now, and have honest conversations about what is coming.

***

## What You'll Learn

By the end of this unit, you will be able to:

* Protect your privacy when you use AI
* Recognize real AI scams
* Describe how AI is changing jobs right now
* Think about how AI changes the news you see
